model.name: YOLOv8 classification candidate
model.sourceUrl: owner-required official or self-trained YOLOv8 classification model source
model.onnxExportCommand: yolo export model=yolov8n-cls.pt format=onnx imgsz=224 opset=17 simplify=True dynamic=False batch=1 device=cpu

labels.sourceUrl: owner-required exact model label source; official YOLOv8n-cls uses the pinned ImageNet.yaml map values, not its simplified names values

input.preprocessCommand: owner-required command that performs resize/crop/RGB/normalize/NCHW conversion

commands.yoloVisionRunCommand: dotnet run --project .\applications\YoloVision -- --model .\models\yolov8n-cls.onnx --labels .\models\imagenet-yolov8n-cls.names --input-data .\models\yolov8n-cls-fp32.bin --input-shape 1x3x224x224 --tensor-rt-line 10 --family v8 --task cls --classification-output output0 --classification-score-mode probabilities --confidence 0 --top-k 5

proofChecklist.notProofUntil: owner backfills real assets for classification, labels, hashes, run log, stdout/stderr summaries, and validator passes
proofChecklist.packageConsumerBoundary: This candidate can support real-model-runtime only; package-consumer-runtime must come from clean external package consumer validators.
